recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source edit is warranted unless a newer work-group decision reopens the deferred questions about additional Media elements or ImagingStudy boundaries.
issue_request: FHIR-14146 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested review of the old MediaSubtype value set because it mixed DICOM/FHIR media subtype values with SNOMED procedure concepts. The accepted motion was to change Media sub-type to modality as applied and remove SNOMED procedures from the associated value set.
initial_application: No commit explicitly tagged FHIR-14146 was found. The matching historical source change is commit 33340aa98afbb0a0c87dad22c4e7311253b21d4d, whose subject says '[#14881] change media sub-type to modality and remove snowed from binding' and whose patch changed the Media binding to MediaModality, switched the reference to valueset-media-modality, and added the Media Modality value set.
additional_context: OO January 2018 minutes record the same tracker item, rationale, vote, and scope: mediaSubtype mixed acquisition modality with procedures/body sites, and the accepted fix was to trim the modality value set by removing SNOMED CT codes and rename subtype to modality while leaving other possible Media elements and ImagingStudy boundary clarification for later discussion. Later terminology refactors moved media-modality to terminology.hl7.org and removed local UTG code system content without reintroducing Media.subtype or SNOMED procedure binding. A commented fhir.ini line ';Media.subtype=Media.modality' is migration metadata, not an active element definition. FHIR-9731 is an older background issue about the old media subtype value set expansion being broken.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/fhir.ini actively includes Media, source/media/media-spreadsheet.xml defines Media.modality bound to MediaModality, and source/media/valueset-media-modality.xml composes DICOM CID 29 plus the HL7 media-modality code system without SNOMED or Phlebography-style procedure concepts.

related_jiras.note: Older Published report that the media subtype value set expansion was broken; it explains why this area had prior terminology problems but is not the same accepted rename/SNOMED-removal decision.
